name: valley-last-16px-plants
label: pixellab-valley-last-16px-plants
provenance: PixelLab Pro grids on the paid account (trial1), group B of lane valley-last-16px (public #917): our own 16 px sprites x4 as shape references, the kit's rich sapling, stump and bush_berry as level and camera references, and crops of the picked painted still (docs/design/frames/2026-11-22-valley-look-B-picked.png) as colour and finish references. DECISIONS 2026-11-02 PixelLab draws the world's pieces.

inputs.description: a big mature oak tree, a thick gnarled brown trunk with rough bark and spreading roots, a very wide rounded crown of layered clumps of muted olive moss-green leaves, sunlit on the upper left and deep shadow green below, a few dark gaps in the foliage, healthy and old. Seen from high above at fifty degrees, the game's three-quarter top-down view, soft light from the upper left, painterly pixel art with many shades, no thick black outline, the whole object alone on a transparent background.

reference_images.usage_description: The object to redraw: the same oak, same pose, same proportions and silhouette (round crown, short trunk), drawn far richer with fine pixels. Do not copy its coarse pixels or its bright green.

The colour and the finish to match: the valley's painted trees, dark muted olive moss-green leaves (not bright lime or pure green), soft light, fine pixels. Only the colours, the leaf clumping and the finish; do not copy the picture.
Only the level of finish, the camera and the light of the game's kit: three-quarter top-down view from high above at fifty degrees, painterly pixel art with many shades. Do not copy this stump.

jobs.note: oak, one Pro grid at its final canvas; the valley's painted trees (crop of the picked still B) set the colour, our 16 px oak the shape.
